entries.title: gunnchOS Device OS and Product Lab
program_outcomes: Write testable user stories and non-functional requirements for a Device OS surface.
Map system architecture across apps, services, and capability adapters without inventing unmerged hardware.
Exercise digital Device Lab / simulator paths before any PHYSICAL_PENDING step.
Apply accessibility, privacy, and security review checklists to a release candidate.
Produce a portfolio packet with provenance, claim boundary, and reproducibility notes.

notes: Aggregated from packages when present; absence is recorded as gap.
Does not claim learner portfolios were submitted.
